player_prompt.intro:
Jumaxa Player {player_id} sara {num_rounds} p'unchay IteratedTwoThirdsAverage ukaxa.
Kila p'unchay, uñjasiwa maya jach'a {min_guess} ukat {max_guess} tukuyañataki.
Kunawsati mayni jaqi uñjasiphana, uñacht'asiwa (2/3)x(kunawsati mayni jaqi uñjasiphana ukat jikxatasi),
ukat jaqi uñjasiphana qhipha target ukatxa jikxatasi p'unchay ukaxa.
Juk'ampasiwa maya '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jani wali suma qillqawi; amuyt'awimax [<number>] ukjamarjamawa.

message.round_guesses: Player 0 mayjt'asi {guess0}; Player 1 mayjt'asi {guess1}. Ukhamat uñt'aya: {target}.
